display_fil: Kaso: May batang nangangati at pinaghihinalaang may bulate
display_en: Case: A child is suspected of having worms
narration_fil: May batang nangangati at pinaghihinalaang may bulate. Gustong pumitas ng buto ng Niyog-niyogan ang kapitbahay.
narration_en: A child is suspected of having worms. A neighbor wants to pick Niyog-niyogan seeds.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Quisqualis indica. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay buto; ang paksang gamit ay bulate sa bituka na kailangang kumpirmahin. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Ipasuri ang bata sa health center para sa diagnosis at angkop na deworming plan.
narration_en: Find Quisqualis indica on the reference card. The listed part is seeds; the use topic is intestinal worms requiring confirmation. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Refer the child to the health center for diagnosis and an appropriate deworming plan.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Niyog-niyogan ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Niyog-niyogan part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Niyog-niyogan.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Niyog-niyogan is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_fil: Itinuro ng BHW ang Niyog-niyogan at botanical name sa card. Hindi niya pinaghulaang tama ang halamang nasa bakuran. Ipasuri ang bata sa health center para sa diagnosis at angkop na deworming plan.
narration_en: The BHW points to Niyog-niyogan and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Refer the child to the health center for diagnosis and an appropriate deworming plan.

narration_fil: Maaaring makapinsala ang maling halaman o dami ng buto. Huwag magbigay ng buto sa bata batay sa table sa lumang manual. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: Wrong identity or seed amount can harm. Do not give seeds to a child from the old manual’s table. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.

narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Niyog-niyogan. Mark the botanical name, seeds, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
